title: Limit Max Photos per Album
text:
## Limit Max Photos per Album
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000056879

## Overview
Creating photo albums is a highly beneficial feature for members in certain industries, such as real estate, design and more. With the Limit Max Photos per Album add-on, reward the higher-tier members by allowing them to publish more photos per album than the lower-tier members.
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Limit Max Photos Per Album Add-On

## Enable the Add-On
1. Go to Finance >> Membership Plans
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092252413/original/1wfWBR9hMAiXa1y7uId7bKU3Za0SFjXDKg.png?1620263487 | alt: ]
2. Click Edit for the level the admin wishes to modify the limit to.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092252426/original/9XkUQ6ZTd9VeFCNVtfVdb2TIOZIEBpGcIg.png?1620263524 | alt: ]
3. Click on the Post Publishing tab.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092252437/original/zTLH2I_IP4cr4FYGe3bhNA3MTkqk_sv7qA.png?1620263560 | alt: ]
4. The admin can limit the number of images that the member can upload per photo album:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092252481/original/Wcv8k_PUoMeFijoCCLSrWtoyYJ-DNApsMg.png?1620263720 | alt: ]
